pages.text: The $(thing)Beneath$() is a network of very deep caves, directly below the Overworld.$(br)This dimension is balanced around mid to late $(thing)Metallurgy Age$().$(br2)It's more dangerous than the surface, so we recommend a metal shield and good nutrition as a minimum, but some armor, a water flask, cooling clothes, and a ranged weapon will help a lot.
它与普通下界体验有几个不同之处：$(li)进入方式 $(l:beneath/beneath#entering)不同$()$(li)水不会立即蒸发$(li)床仍像平常一样使用$(li)在底层移动速度不快于主世界$(br2)作为回报，你可以找到诸如 $(thing)高岭土$()、$(thing)石墨$()、更丰富且暴露的 $(thing)矿脉$()，以及其他珍宝。

Not like this!

pages.title: 进入幽冥之地
pages.text: To travel Beneath, simply find some overworld Bedrock at $(thing)Y=-58$().$(br2)To get down to the bedrock, you'll have to either break through the Hornfels layer with $(item)Explosives$() or $(item)Steel+ Tools$(), find a cave with the more brittle $(thing)Keratophyre$(), or drain a lava lake.

You will appear in the Beneath at the same X and Z coordinates, with a 3x2x3 space opened for you to place some supports if necessary.$(br2)A temporary cloud will be provided if there is no floor, as well as short $(thing)Slow Falling$() and $(thing)Fire Protection$() effects to prevent any accidents.

pages.title: Exiting the Beneath
pages.text: To return, just get up to ceiling bedrock in the same fashion.$(br2)It's a good idea to $(thing)make a note$() of where you entered, so you can return to the same place in the overworld whenever you're ready to leave.

You will be returned at $(thing)Y=-54$(), above any potential lava lakes, inside another 3x2x3 area. The middle two blocks for the player will always be replaced by air, so you may want to avoid placing ladders there.

pages.title: 生物群系
pages.text: The Beneath has a full set of new biomes to explore!$(br2)The Beneath can be split into three vertical layers, each with their own set of biomes. Each one is more hot and dangerous as you descend!

pages.title: 盐窟
pages.text: 像温暖的海风，这个生物群系充满了$(item)岩盐$()。是建立基地的好地方！

pages.title: 闷热泥沼
pages.text: 潮湿且类似沼泽。如果能避开$(thing)鳄鱼$()，这里是一个安全的木材来源。

pages.title: 蛛网巢穴
pages.text: 大自然的分解者在这个充满腐烂的潮湿区域辛勤工作。

pages.title: 灰烬森林
pages.text: No prizes for guessing what lives here! A great place to harvest $(item)Silk$().

pages.title: 熔岩浮岛
pages.text: 沙质地面宛如小型沙漠，遍布富含石油的黏稠$(thing)焦油坑$()。

pages.title: 地热泉
pages.text: 这里没有硫磺块，但这个热气腾腾的生物群系是寻找$(thing)温泉$()的好地方，可用于治疗。

pages.title: 荆棘林地
pages.text: 难以穿越的生物群系，踩到植物会受其影响。小心！

pages.title: 繁茂空谷
pages.text: 炎热且充满绿植！茂密的蕨类植物下隐藏着$(thing)高岭土$()。

pages.title: 灰烬森林
pages.text: What remains of the upper greenery after the frequent fires caused by the heat.

pages.title: 熔岩浮岛
pages.text: 富含矿产的$(thing)辉石岩$()地区，被岩浆河流纵横切割。

pages.title: 玄武岩三角洲
pages.text: Everyone's favourite Nether biome returns, and is just as dangerous to navigate as ever.

pages.title: 地质学
pages.text: Like the overworld, the Beneath has its own set of rock layers. At the very top, you may find Phyllite, Schist, Gneiss, Marble, Slate, Migmatite, and Travertine.$(br2)Underneath those, you may find Schist, Gneiss, Tuff, Migmatite, Travertine, and Diorite.
Below that is either Gabbro, Granite, Tuff, Diorite, or Migmatite.$(br2)At the lower levels of the Beneath, there is a layer of exclusively Migmatite, followed by Pyroxenite at the very bottom.

pages.title: More Rocks
pages.text: Some other stones can be found in other locations.$(br2)Small lava pools are surrounded by $(item)Pyroxenite$(), while $(item)Calcite$() can be found in spring water pools.$(br2)$(item)Keratophyre$() can be found all over the Beneath in large, tall columns.

The $(thing)Geothermal Springs$() biome contains the exclusive $(item)Aragonite$() and $(item)Glauberite$(), along with more Calcite.$(br2)This biome also houses $(item)Huge Quartz$() crystals, which can either be broken with a pickaxe to obtain $(item)Smoky Quartz$() gems of varying quality, or broken with a $(item)Gem Saw$() to obtain the transparent block itself.

$(item)Gilsonite$(), a very dark building block and ingredient of $(l:logistics/roads#asphalt)Asphalt$(), can be found in large quantities in the $(thing)Tar Pools$() biome, along with $(item)Sandstone$().$(br2)Finally, $(item)Halite$() can be found in massive quantities in the $(thing)Salt Caves$() biome, which can be mined for Halite and Sylvite ores.
